tools.name: search_language_schools
tools.description: Search and rank language schools. Returns school_id, url, indicative from-price, reviews. Prices are not a booking quote.

tools.name: search_destinations
tools.description: Search cities, countries and school names. Use to resolve a place before searching schools.

tools.name: get_school_filters
tools.description: Valid filter values for search_language_schools (languages, cities, course types, etc.).

tools.name: get_school
tools.description: School briefing: profile, cancellation, reviews, image URLs, and a hero image. Pass school_id from search.

tools.name: list_courses
tools.description: Live course catalogue for a bookings_live school (ids, weeks, prices). Use these ids in save_trip.

tools.name: list_starting_dates
tools.description: Allowed course start dates (typically Mondays) for a school.

tools.name: list_accommodations
tools.description: Accommodation groups for a school. Use group ids in save_trip.

tools.name: get_course_details
tools.description: Details for one course id from list_courses.

tools.name: get_accommodation_details
tools.description: Details for one accommodation group id from list_accommodations.

tools.name: calculate_trip_price
tools.description: Live checkout quote for a configuration. Not a booking. Call this before create_booking.

tools.name: save_trip
tools.description: Create or update a server-side trip draft. Returns trip_id, url (legacy), trip_url, and continue_url (/s/{id}) so the student can continue on Extralingo.com with selections restored. Not a booking. Requires OAuth trips scope (Bearer token).

tools.name: get_trip
tools.description: Load a saved trip by trip_id. Returns continue_url for website handoff with the configuration restored.

tools.name: email_trip
tools.description: Email continue_url (/s/{id}) to the verified account email. Requires OAuth trips scope. Rate-limited. This is not a booking. Without auth, share continue_url from save_trip instead.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Makes a real unpaid booking with the school. The school still confirms availability. A down payment is due within 5 days of the school's confirmation via Extralingo only. Requires a credential (OAuth bookings scope or a legacy auth_token), idempotencyKey and phone. Contact email is always the verifi

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Ask the school for a personal quote. Use when bookings_live is false, or the student is not ready to book. Requires OAuth requests scope. Optional idempotency_key avoids duplicate quotes on retry. Contact email is always the verified account email.

tools.name: request_discussion
tools.description: Open a trip discussion with the school. Requires OAuth requests scope. Optional idempotency_key avoids duplicate threads on retry. Contact email is always the verified account email.

tools.name: ask_school_question
tools.description: Send a question to the school without a full trip config. Requires OAuth requests scope. Optional idempotency_key avoids duplicate questions on retry. Contact email is always the verified account email.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "save_trip" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.detail: Description of "create_booking" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_language_schools, get_school, request_discussion · Private data: save_trip, create_booking, request_quote, request_discussion, ask_school_question · Public sink: email_trip, create_booking, request_quote, request_discussion, ask_school_question.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_language_schools, get_school, request_discussion · Private data: save_trip, create_booking, request_quote, request_discussion, ask_school_question · Public sink: email_trip, create_booking, request_quote, request_discussion, ask_school_question

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
